Question: Let \(S\) be the set \(\{1, 2, 3, \ldots, 19\}.\) For \(a,\) \(b \in S,\) define \(a \succ b\) to mean that either \(0 \lt a - b \le 9\) or \(b - a \gt 9.\) How many ordered triples \((x, y, z)\) of elements of \(S\) have the property that \(x \succ y,\) \(y \succ z,\) and \(z \succ x?\)
